initialization: Exact same fully trained uniform101 actor/critic/posterior/replay;fresh matched actor Adam;zero residual-router final layer;copied online actor target.
gate: learned:softmax(delta_phi(detached history/stage/proposal descriptors));uniform:constant.25 bypasses all gate networks
warmup: Experts/fusion/commander/history frozen in both arms;learned trains residual router;uniform actor has no trainable parameter and200 no-op actor steps,while native critic/posterior train.
joint: Same trainable experts/fusion/commander/history1800 updates;only learned router trainable;inherited gate networks frozen/unused in both.
objective: Only unmodified native full-horizon variational actor-critic EIG,use_PCE=False,discount1;no extra loss/reward.

diagnostic.purpose: Paired one-step gate interventions followed by identical uniform suffixes,common latent/base noise;critic comparison;fresh bank only. Single future per history;not exact conditional Q.
diagnostic.training_selection: Fixed exploratory trial runs regardless of diagnostic outcome;no hyperparameter/checkpoint selection using diagnostic or primary test EIG.

evaluation.checkpoint_selection: Terminal2000 only;common parameter and base-noise draws;unchanged primary benchmark protocol.

scope: Additional seed101 warm-start comparison,not replacement of completed five-seed benchmark. Inherits all uniform101 pretraining. Single-seed case CI cannot show seed robustness. Learned diagnostic incurs additional compute,reported separately.
